Field Notes / Rental guide

When Temporary Fence Panels Are the Right Fit

Portable panels for construction phases, event footprints, and sites where driven posts are unsuitable.

Request a quoteCall Richard(317) 296-4015

Rental guide · Fence Wizards

How panels and stands work

Freestanding panels sit in bases weighted with sandbags. They form a temporary boundary above the ground without driven posts, which makes them useful on concrete, asphalt, and other suitable surfaces.

Fence Wizards carries six-foot panels, with eight-foot options available. Ask about the required height when quoting so availability can be confirmed.

For a site that changes

Panels are useful when the construction layout changes between phases. A crew can move individual sections to adjust an access point; larger relocations can be handled by Fence Wizards.

That flexibility also suits events, where a perimeter goes in during load-in and comes out after the event. Barricades can be rented alongside panels for queues or other areas within the footprint.

Plan the access points

Tell Richard where deliveries arrive and what must pass through each entrance. Pedestrian and drive gates can be included in the run.

Avoid treating gate positions as whatever space is left after the fence is laid out. The access plan should help determine the boundary from the start.

Screening and site exposure

Plain or custom printed windscreen can be fitted for privacy, dust control, or graphics. It is sold separately and remains yours after the rental.

Screen increases wind load. The location, support, and weighting need to be considered together, so mention screening requirements before installation.

When to choose something more fixed

Panels are portable by design. Where the perimeter will stay in one place for a long period and portability is a drawback, consider post-driven chain link.

The choice also depends on whether the ground accepts posts. Richard can discuss both systems using the location, approximate footage, gate plan, and expected duration.

Quote, setup, and pickup

The normal installation window is 24–48 hours, with panels often possible sooner. Confirm your date directly with Richard.

The flat-fee quote includes installation and removal for the agreed term. Standard rentals cover up to 12 months, with short-term discounts available.
